title: Source Gap Register Entry
description: One entry in the Source Gap Register (data/registry/gaps.yaml). Lists needed but unverified facts with the next check date and a verification item id. A gap entry without a verification id fails the data gate. Spec: Part 3 §3.12, P02-T03.

source_id.description: Identifier matching a source_id in data/registry/sources.yaml.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why this entry is in the gap register (e.g. 'terms not verified').

v_item.description: Verification item id (V-xx) that must be closed to remove this gap. Must not be empty.

next_check.description: Month by which this gap should be revisited (YYYY-MM format).

notes.description: Optional additional notes about this gap or its resolution path.
